A full-code app in Windmill is a React or Svelte project with backend runnables, deployed like any other item. An AI session builds one from a description.
Describe the app you need. The AI creates it as a draft, and opens it in the preview, next to the chat.
It writes the frontend files, and the backend runnables the page calls.
A backend runnable is code that runs on a Windmill worker, not in the browser. Here, approve marks an expense as approved in Postgres, through a database resource the browser never sees.
The page calls it like a function: backend dot approve. Windmill runs it as a job, and sends the result back to the page.
When a build fails, the AI reads the build logs itself, and fixes the code in the same turn.
Try it in the preview, then deploy it from the editor's header. The draft becomes a real app in your workspace.
